name: Link (The Minish Cap) — Playable Character, Hyrule & Dark World
author: HyruleChosenOne
tagline: Playable Link (unlocked by default!) with 9 Minish Cap items & sword moves, Light Arrows Primary Fusion, Four Sword Ultimate, plus Hyrule Castle & Dark World Pyramid levels!
description: Playable Link from The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap (unlocked by default!) with full 8-direction animated sprites, Four Sword Red shiny variant, 9 authentic Minish Cap Sword & Item attacks (Picori Blade, Hero's Bow, Gust Jar, Magical Boomerang, Flame Lantern, Cane of Pacci, Mole Mitts, Remote Bombs, Roc's Cape), Light Arrows Primary Signature Fusion, Four Sword Hurricane Spin Ultimate, 4 Minish Cap Pokéball items, and 2 unlocked Zelda levels — Hyrule Field (Hyrule Castle POI) and The Dark World (Pyramid of Power POI) — built with custom Nano Banana pixel-art spritework & full PokéBonk-native collision.
highlights: Link & both Zelda levels are 100% unlocked by default the moment you enable the mod

2 custom Zelda levels with bespoke Nano Banana pixel-art spritework & full PokéBonk-native collision: Hyrule Field (featuring Hyrule Castle POI) and The Dark World (featuring the Pyramid of Power POI)
Complete Minish Cap Sword & Items moveset (9 custom moves & GPU VFX): Picori Blade, Hero's Bow, Gust Jar, Magical Boomerang, Flame Lantern, Cane of Pacci, Mole Mitts, Remote Bombs, and Roc's Cape
Primary Signature Fusion: Light Arrows (Picori Blade + Hero's Bow) unleashing piercing golden arrows & Triforce radiance — plus his signature Four Sword Hurricane Spin Ultimate
4 Minish Cap Pokéball items (Gold Kinstone, Pegasus Boots, Mirror Shield, Ocarina of Wind) & 11-language global translation
Includes authentic A Link to the Past Overworld & Dark World SNES music tracks mapped directly to Hyrule Field & The Dark World (zero audio overlap)
